description: A received HTTP response carries a non-2xx status code. The mapping treats this as a server-error outcome, preserving the numeric status code and exposing the error payload content as the result's error body; when the error response had no content the error body is the empty string (still present, not absent), and any headers present are carried through in a stable name-sorted order. These cases probe the lower edge just above the success range, a high server-side code, a forbidden-style code with an explicitly empty payload, a no-body error declared via the success-type hint, and multi-header carry-through ordering on an error outcome.
